design_concept: Premium Art Exhibition meets Modern Social Media. The UI steps back to let the art be the hero. Inspired by gallery walls, high-end editorial design, and seamless consumer commerce.

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) for large headings. Use for hero sections, artist names, and product titles.

body.usage: Clean, legible, modern body copy. Use for descriptions, bios, and standard UI text.

accent.usage: Use for metadata, artwork dimensions, prices, and small UI labels. Must be uppercase with wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

rules: Accent color (Signal Red) must be used sparingly—only for primary conversion actions (Buy, Follow, Custom Order) or active indicators (like a gallery 'sold' dot).
Avoid Teal Green, Teal Blue, and #7351B7 completely.
Do not use generic gradients. Backgrounds should be stark and monochrome.
Dark mode is preferred for reels and discovery to make colors pop, while profiles can utilize stark white light mode.

layouts.discovery_feed: Masonry Grid layout. Images must have varied heights, spanning 2-4 columns on desktop, 1 on mobile. Generous gap-8 between items.
layouts.reels: Full-screen vertical snap scrolling (100vh containers). Floating UI elements overlaid using Glassmorphism.
layouts.artist_portfolio: Bento Grid (Tetris Mode A). Asymmetrical layout featuring 1 dominant hero piece (col-span-8 row-span-2) and smaller supporting pieces. Use gap-8.
layouts.dashboard_analytics: High Density Grid (Mode B) for creators and retailers. Tight gaps (gap-4). Pure functional data display.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8, p-12, or p-16 for sections. Do not cram elements together.

surfaces_and_components.art_cards: Cardless or Rectangular. 0px border radius (rounded-none) to mimic physical canvases or frames. No heavy drop shadows. In light mode, use a 1px subtle border; in dark mode, rely on spacing.
surfaces_and_components.headers_navigation: Crystal Glassmorphism. If content scrolls underneath, use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/60 (dark) with a delicate 1px inner stroke. NEVER use a completely transparent background.
surfaces_and_components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or very slight radius (rounded-sm). High contrast. Primary buttons should use the accent red or inverted monochrome.
surfaces_and_components.forms_inputs: Use Shadcn components. Strip the default rounded borders to match the sharp gallery aesthetic.
surfaces_and_components.data_display: Use Shadcn Table and Charts (Recharts). Keep charts monochrome with the accent color for the primary metric.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Artwork images must scale slightly (scale-105) on hover with a slow transition (duration-500 ease-out). Text color must explicitly change on interactive elements.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Use Framer Motion for smooth fade-ins and staggered list animations when loading masonry grids.
motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Implement 'lenis' for smooth scrolling on desktop to give the site a premium, weighty feel.

visual_enhancers.overlays: Hero image overlays max bg-black/40. If text needs contrast, use a gradient overlay fading to transparent, not a flat blanket.
visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle noise/grain texture overlaid on the background via a fixed CSS mix-blend-mode layer to eliminate digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use minimalist line-art or elegant typography. No cartoonish illustrations.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, links, and forms MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='buy-now-button').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets WCAG AA standards. Focus states must have higher contrast.

media.image_usage_rules: Always use provided URLs. Do not use placeholder services. Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile devices.

general: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Do not center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Never use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Implement a robust Dark/Light mode toggle since the platform serves both content consumption (Dark preferred) and management (Light preferred).
Do not apply 'transition: all' globally. Target specific properties.
Ensure z-index hierarchy is respected for sticky headers and overlays.
Use pre-existing Shadcn components from /app/frontend/src/components/ui/ when possible.
If you need to use Shadcn components that are not HTML standard (like Select, Dialog, Calendar), use the Shadcn implementation.
Code is in JavaScript (.js, .jsx), NOT TypeScript. Do not include TS interfaces or types.
